## Problem and change
Describe the user-visible problem and resulting behavior.

## Verification
List automated checks and any actual PBX/device testing. Distinguish simulated UI or null-audio tests from real calls.

## Scope
- [ ] Uses PJSIP for SIP and media; no new custom protocol stack.
- [ ] Preserves one account and one active call unless a broader change was discussed.

- [ ] Documentation and relevant tests reflect the change.
